text: Bitcoin's 11.5% surge and Ethereum's stronger 19% gain suggest growing confidence in both the core assets and smart-contract platforms, with Ethereum's outperformance indicating appetite for risk beyond store-of-value narratives. The Fear & Greed index at 62 (Greed) and up 33 points in a week signals a rapid sentiment shift from neutral to optimistic, though still short of euphoria. Bitcoin's dominance holding steady near 59% while alts rally broadly, combined with elevated 24-hour volume of $156B, points to a healthy risk-on environment where capital is rotating into higher-conviction positions rather than fleeing to safety.
